items.title: The blowing up is final among morphisms making the inverse image of Z Cartier
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a closed subscheme Z of a scheme X, the blowing up X' -> X is a final object of the full subcategory of (Sch/X) consisting of those Y -> X whose inverse image of Z is an effective Cartier divisor (source lines 8433-8440). The proof first shows the blowing up itself lies in the subcategory, then takes f : Y -> X in it, uses that f^*I -> I_D is a surjection onto an invertible module to build a map of graded algebras bigoplus f^*I^d -> bigoplus I_D^d, invokes the relative Proj material to obtain a morphism Y -> X' over X, and proves uniqueness by restricting to the scheme theoretically dense open Y \ D and applying equality of morphisms into the separated X'.
